title: Blue dwarfs drag a man behind a curtain at the 'horror store'
place_text: between 7th Avenue and Broadway, near West 55th Street, Manhattan

tellings.quote: there's a guy trying to in a brown suit trying to get out and he's being pulled back by these blue dwarfs.

plain: Whitley Strieber, a writer known for describing his own encounters with beings he believes are not human, told this to podcast host Jesse Michels. He says that in the 1970s, at a shop he calls the "horror store" near West 55th Street in Manhattan, between 7th Avenue and Broadway, he saw a man in a brown suit trying to get out from behind a curtain while blue dwarfs pulled him back. He mentions Anne Strieber in the story, and tells it as a sign that such beings move among us.
